name: Witch's Brew
summary: Wizard role-selection game where players contest actions to collect ingredients and brew point-valued potions.
rules_text: Each player has 12 role cards and visible ingredients and gold. A set starts with each player secretly choosing 5 roles to hold. The start player plays a role face-up and claims it. Clockwise, each other player who holds that same role must reveal it and choose: contest by claiming the role for themselves, forcing the previous claimant to discard with nothing, or accept the weaker favor and then discard. Players without the role pass. The last unchallenged claimant must execute the full action. Winner starts next round. A role cannot be played twice in a set. When all 5 cards are spent, a new set starts with a fresh selection of 5. The game ends when collectively at least four raven potions have been taken; score is potion points plus vial tokens.
rating_reason: Role selection wizards, potion brewing, hidden roles and bluffing.
